BackstoryDef.title: exceptional chapter serf
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was a child of two serfs belonging to a space marine chapter, and was born into a life of service and toil for [PAWN_possessive] transhuman masters. The chapter's apothecaries noticed [PAWN_possessive] potential, however, and [PAWN_pronoun] was picked to undergo the process of induction as an aspirant.

BackstoryDef.title: space marine
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] underwent extensive training as a Neophyte in a Space Marine Chapter, and subsequently went through the lengthy process of surgery, genetic modification, and indoctrination to become a full-fledged Astartes. [PAWN_pronoun] is now a genetically enhanced superhuman, one of the Emperor’s Angels of Death, made entirely for war.

BackstoryDef.title: techmarine
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was inducted as a full battle brother of a Space Marine chapter and demonstrated a surprising affinity for machines. [PAWN_pronoun] was sent to a forge world of the Adeptus Mechanicus for additional doctrinal and practical training, and now serves as a link between the Cult of Mars and the Angels of Death.

BackstoryDef.title: apothecary
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was inducted as a full battle-brother of a Space Marine Chapter and subsequently trained in the rituals and duties of an Apothecary. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to provide battlefield medical care, oversee the recovery of wounded Astartes between battles, and extract and preserve the geneseed of fallen brothers.

BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Whatever [PAWN_pronoun] was before [PAWN_possessive] transformation matters not. [PAWN_nameDef] is a Custodian now.

BackstoryDef.title: Custodian
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was transformed into one of the Custodes, the legendary Ten Thousand, through an extensive process of genetic modification, indoctrination, and training. [PAWN_pronoun] became the pinnacle of human achievement, a warrior with superhuman senses and a terrifying adversary to [PAWN_possessive] foes. [PAWN_nameDef] shows a particular inclination toward martial pursuits.
